gameDescriptionHtml:
Embark on an extraordinary journey in Wéko the Mask Gatherer, a single-player, action-adventure game inspired by classic 3D platformers and RPGs like Zelda (OOT), Souls-like, and Spyro. As Wéko, the intrepid adventurer and mask gatherer, you will traverse a progressively open world that encourages discovery. Use the power of masks to solve intriguing puzzles, overcome various missions, and uncover the many secrets hidden within this vast and enchanting world.

Game Features

  • Combat – Experience a combat system inspired by the Zelda retro series, such as Ocarina of Time, with a touch of Souls-like mechanics for added depth. Enjoy battles that are accessible and fun, leveraging the unique abilities of each mask.
  • Explore – Discover diverse landscapes, from the vibrant and dreamy hues of Houshi Village to the shrouded whispers of the Dark Forest, each meticulously crafted to evoke emotions as deep as the depths of the Underground, where treacherous waters laden with poison challenge the bravest adventurers.
  • Puzzle – Dive into Wéko’s world full of puzzles. Help a farmer find his missing animals or solve complex puzzles to reach and obtain the seven Primordial Masks.
  • A Single-Player, Action-Adventure Game: Inspired by classic 3D platformers and RPGs like Zelda (OOT), Souls-like, and Spyro.
  • Collectible Masks: Grant Wéko unique abilities and powers to aid him on his quest. Customize Wéko for distance or melee combat to suit your playstyle.
  • Engaging Combat Mechanics: Challenge your skills while enjoying a cozy gaming experience.
  • Vast and Beautiful Fantasy World: Explore diverse landscapes, from the vibrant and dreamy hues of Houshi Village to the mysterious shadows of the Dark Forest, and the treacherous Underground with its poisonous waters.
  • Intriguing Puzzles and Detailed Environments: Solve puzzles and uncover secrets in a meticulously crafted world.
  • Emotional Storyline: Follow Wéko’s journey, filled with heartwarming moments and challenging trials.
  • 8-12 Hours of Gameplay: Complete the main storyline with plenty of side quests and secrets to uncover.
  • Full Controller Support: Enjoy customizable controls to enhance your gameplay experience.
